ops.text: 10.3 Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form for any reason, Vendor shall (a) at Customer's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Vendor's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Customer's request, return or make available for export all Customer Data in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete Customer Data from its systems, subject to routine backups and legal retention requirements, and certify such deletion in writing.

input.comment: [Playbook] We have added an exit clause: the Agreement currently ends Customer's access after an undefined "agreed transition period" with no obligation to return Customer Data or assist with migration. Our playbook requires up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, data return in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and certified deletion thereafter; we can work with 90 days of assistance if that is easier for you.
input.summary: Insert transition assistance, data return and certified deletion obligations in Section 10.
